desc:
(The game is still in the beta phase, so expect bugs!)

Hitboxes depend on your ping.

A game where the Weakest Dummy from The Strongest Battlegrounds had enough and actually fights back against you.

The characters are mixed, they can be from an anime or even other games.

Please report bugs, exploiters in our community server. (it helps alot!)

🖥️Controls
G - Awakening Mode (if full)
F - Block
Q - Dash (use when ragdolled to evasive.)
M1 - Punch
B - Emote Wheel
(Mobile players have buttons to play)

(Assets that are not ours is a placeholder. they will IMMEDIATELY get changed when we have the assets.)
